method: Two random samples re-read against each post's full text by a second model (Claude, in the build session), not by a person: 50 help-forum posts (seed 7) and 30 posts from Reddit, Play Store, App Store, Hacker News and Stack Exchange (seed 11).

disagreements.note: Google Lens safe-search, not photo retrieval
old photos missing from face groups is an indexing gap
face grouping broken (index_gap stage was right)
faces not being identified = index gap
deleting search history is not a retrieval failure
filtering videos to free storage, not retrieval
generic 'search returns nothing', no specific photo

pattern: Two error patterns. (1) Face-grouping failures are sometimes tagged off-goal, which undercounts the index-gap area. (2) Short praise and general Hacker News chatter is sometimes tagged search_feedback, which slightly inflates feedback counts but rarely creates false retrieval stories.
